chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch 381: Hunted by Twin Skeleton Kings in the Death World
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen, a yellow diamond skeleton, is pursued by a five-colored skeleton and a white bone king. He lures them to the mortal world and unleashes the stone giant in a desperate battle.
og_title: Death World Arc: The Five-Colored Skeleton's Pursuit
og_description: Xiao Chen's desperate flight from two death world kings leads to an explosive confrontation with the stone giant in the mortal world.
twitter_title: Ch 381: Twin Skeleton Kings Chasing Xiao Chen
twitter_description: Xiao Chen escapes the death world pursuit by sacrificing his yellow diamond body and commanding the stone giant to destroy one king.
